summary: Completed backend regression and focused frontend checks for profile, communities, direct messaging, missions, navigation, and admin selector.

critical.issue: Completing an already completed mission returns 200 and awards XP again; repeated mission-6 completion increased XP twice by 60.

action_items: Make mission completion idempotent: do not award XP when progress already equals goal, and return an appropriate completed response.
Remove the fallback hardcoded backend URL from the existing regression test and require the configured environment variable.
critical_code_review_comments: complete_mission unconditionally increments student XP, allowing unlimited repeated rewards; guard on mission progress or persist completion state.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; existing demo records and test messages were used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bootstrap, profile persistence, community/direct message GET+POST, join/leave, navigation, chat opening, responsive desktop load, and console error scan passed. Re-test mission completion twice after fixing duplicate XP; frontend logs showed only webpack deprecation warnings and one transient compile error that cleared on rebuild.
rca of the issue: POST /api/missions/mission-6/complete always executes db.students.update_one with $inc XP after reading the mission, without checking mission.progress against mission.goal or recording a completion. Reproduce by POSTing the same mission twice and comparing bootstrap student.xp; mitigation is an atomic conditional update or an early completed response.
